_about: Where each field shows. Read by scripts/import/check_rendered_fields.php, which fails on a page field whose value is not on its page, and on any field holding data that is not listed here. page: a template shows it; schema: JSON-LD or meta only, on purpose; internal: never shown, on purpose, with why; gap: should show, not built yet (reported, not failed). notOn: sections where a page field is deliberately not shown. unless: a known reason a value may be absent (reported, not failed). Nathan, 2 October 2026; DEPLOY-RUNBOOK section 9.
